title: URL checker with a worker pool
prompt:
Write `CheckURLs(urls <-chan string, workers int, fetch func(url string) (int, error)) <-chan string`.

- Run exactly `workers` goroutines that read URLs and call `fetch`.
- Send `"<url> ok"` for status 200 with no error, else `"<url> not ok"`.
- Close the output once the input is closed and every result is sent.

Order doesn't matter: `a`(200), `b`(404) → `"a ok"`, `"b not ok"`.
hint: Workers `range` over the input; one extra goroutine waits on a `WaitGroup` and closes the output.
